quoted_text: A cut rose variety with very unique coffee-colored, vintage flowers, with a diameter ~3.5 in. It blooms repeatedly throughout the seasons, boasts exquisite flower shapes, a long flowering period, and a light tea fragrance. The plant grows to a height of ~3.5 ft, with an upright, full shape, good branching, and strong disease resistance. It is used as high-end cut roses. *See Disclaimer in the Footer of the webpages
